description: No CRA notified body is designated with capacity before Q2 2027, so Class I/II families cannot be certified by 11 Dec 2027.
mitigation: Pre-contract three candidates with conversion options; Module H for IC to cover five families with one body; check NANDO at every programme board; prioritise top-revenue SKUs.

description: Remediation competes with the 2027 product roadmap for the same engineers.
mitigation: Ring-fence 26 FTE-years in the 2027 plan; defer two roadmap features; contractors for documentation and testing.

risk: No harmonised standard cited for Class I
description: EN 304 6xx verticals are not cited in time, so Class I products cannot use Module A.
mitigation: Plan Class I on third-party routes; align files to draft clause structure; switch to Module A only if a citation lands before assessment.

description: Binary blobs and supplier components without SBOMs or vulnerability notification undermine Annex I Part II(1) and the 24-hour determination.
mitigation: Binary SCA on firmware images; clause pack to top 15 suppliers first; exit plans for refusers.

risk: Legacy lines still sold after 11 Dec 2027
description: IR-300 and IS-200 units placed after 11 Dec 2027 must comply with Annex I.
mitigation: Board decision on 19 Nov 2026 to withdraw from EU sale and migrate customers; remediate only if the decision changes.

description: Awareness misjudged or a stale distribution map delays the 24-hour early warning.
mitigation: Written awareness criteria; deputies with authority to file; distribution map refresh (T10); two drills a year.

description: Versions, companion apps and backends found late enlarge the portfolio.
mitigation: Build the register from release and cloud systems; second reconciliation after the first gate run.

description: Two people hold most PSIRT knowledge; on-call cannot be sustained.
mitigation: Hire PSIRT lead; second analyst; documented runbook; cross-training from IC.

description: Formal adoption of C(2026) 5252 or later FAQ versions change scope or support-period decisions.
mitigation: Decision records cite the guidance version; quarterly standards and guidance review.

description: From 9 Dec 2026 claimants can seek disclosure of technical files and update logs under the PLD.
mitigation: Write records for disclosure; legal review of risk acceptances; align with product liability insurance.
